title: Strict tower exchange agrees with the canonical mate
statement:
Let $\square=(f,f',g,g')$, with $f:X\to Y$, $f':X'\to Y'$, $g:Y'\to Y$ and $g':X'\to X$, be a cartesian square of schemes [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square], with $f$ proper [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let $A,I,P_n=A/I^n,(P_n)_T,A_T$ be the Noetherian adic datum of [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], for all four corners $T$. Let $K\in D(\operatorname{Mod}(A_X))$ be derived complete, meaning its canonical map to the derived inverse limit of its strict reduction tower $K_\bullet$ is an isomorphism [def-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-limit]. For every $n\geq1$, fix an etale-origin witness $L_n\in D^+(X_{\Et},P_n)$ and $\alpha_n:\nu_X^*L_n\simeq K_n$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness]. Let $B_\bullet,D_\bullet$ and the specified morphism $v'_\bullet:B_\bullet\to D_\bullet$ be those of [def-weil-pbc-completed-base-change-map], as morphisms in the derived category of strict towers, not just families of maps in the derived categories at the individual levels.

Write $\underline A_T$ for the constant ring sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] on $T_{\Proet}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], and $\mathcal T_T=\operatorname{Fun}(\mathbf N_{\geq1}^{\mathrm{op}},\operatorname{Mod}(\underline A_T))$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-inverse-system]. Write $\operatorname{Res}_T$ for termwise restriction along $\underline A_T\to A_T$ [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars, lem-weil-pbc-constant-completion-equivalence], and put $\bar K_\bullet=\operatorname{Res}_XK_\bullet$. For each edge $u$, let $G_u=u^{-1}$ on constant-coefficient modules, applied termwise to strict towers, and let $R_u^{\mathcal T}$ be the total right derived termwise direct image. Their derived adjunction $G_u\dashv R_u^{\mathcal T}$ uses the termwise module adjunction of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations] and its derived adjunction [lem-pc-pre-derived-adjoint-functors-general]. Here $D(\mathcal T_T)$ means localization of cochain complexes at quasi-isomorphisms [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $\theta^{\mathcal T}_\square:G_{f'}G_g\simeq G_{g'}G_f$ be the termwise canonical pullback composition square [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-derived-pullback-composition], and let $E^{\mathcal T}_\square:G_gR_f^{\mathcal T}\to R_{f'}^{\mathcal T}G_{g'}$ be its adjunction mate [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate].

Make the strict realization in this reference explicit as follows; this specifies the lift, rather than characterizing it by evaluations. Put $J=\mathbf N_{\geq1}^{\mathrm{op}}$, let $\Delta$ denote the constant $J$-diagram, and use the ringed diagram sites of [lem-weil-pbc-diagram-site-realization] with coefficient ring $\Delta A_T$. On these sites all tensor products below are derived tensor products. Let $Q_{T,\bullet}=((P_n)_T)_n$ be the quotient diagram, and let $\mathcal R_T(F)=\Delta F\otimes^L_{\Delta A_T}Q_{T,\bullet}$; this is the strict reduction functor of [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. Write $\mathscr L_u,\mathscr R_u$ for derived termwise module pullback and direct image with completed coefficients. Set $E=Lg'^*K$, $M=Lg^*Rf_*K$, $N=Rf'_*E$, and $e=\operatorname{Ex}^{A}_{\square,K}:M\to N$, the canonical ambient mate [def-weil-pbc-ambient-ringed-exchange]. The coefficient and tensor identifications in [def-weil-pbc-four-corners] give canonical maps
$$H:\mathcal R_{Y'}(M)\longrightarrow\mathscr L_g\mathscr R_f\mathcal R_X(K),\qquad H':\mathcal R_{Y'}(N)\longrightarrow\mathscr R_{f'}\mathscr L_{g'}\mathcal R_X(K).$$
Here $H$ is $\mathscr L_g$ of the diagram-site projection-formula map for $\Delta K,Q_{Y,\bullet}$, and $H'$ is the analogous map for $\Delta E,Q_{Y',\bullet}$ followed by the pullback/reduction identification. Projection-formula maps mean the adjuncts of counit tensored with the identity, as in [def-weil-pbc-projection-formula-map]. Their evaluations are exactly $h_n,h'_n$ of [def-weil-pbc-four-arrows], and they are isomorphisms by [lemma-weil-pbc-perfect-projection-formula] and [lem-weil-tower-category-levelwise-abelian]. Take the specified strict corners to be the targets of $H,H'$ and the specified strict exchange to be
$$B_\bullet=\mathscr L_g\mathscr R_f\mathcal R_X(K),\quad D_\bullet=\mathscr R_{f'}\mathscr L_{g'}\mathcal R_X(K),\qquad v'_\bullet=H'\,\mathcal R_{Y'}(e)\,H^{-1}.$$
Equivalently one may represent these corners by the source complexes of $H,H'$ and transport their evaluation identifications by $h_n,h'_n$. These are the projection-formula realizations used to supply the towers in [def-weil-pbc-completed-four-towers].

There are canonical natural isomorphisms of derived strict-tower objects
$$b_{\square,K}:\operatorname{Res}_{Y'}B_\bullet\xrightarrow{\sim}G_gR_f^{\mathcal T}\bar K_\bullet,\qquad d_{\square,K}:\operatorname{Res}_{Y'}D_\bullet\xrightarrow{\sim}R_{f'}^{\mathcal T}G_{g'}\bar K_\bullet,$$
induced by the constant-to-completed finite-reduction comparisons of [lem-weil-pbc-constant-completion-equivalence] and the canonical tower direct-image evaluation comparisons of [prop-weil-pbc-direct-image-limits]. With these specified comparisons, the equality
$$d_{\square,K}\circ\operatorname{Res}_{Y'}(v'_\bullet)=E^{\mathcal T}_{\square,\bar K_\bullet}\circ b_{\square,K}$$
holds in $D(\mathcal T_{Y'})$, naturally for morphisms of the input $K$. The equality concerns the specified witness-transported tower map; it asserts no faithfulness of the family of derived evaluation functors.

proof.text: Use the actual termwise module adjunctions and exact restriction. The scalar square follows from the completed scalar/projection identities; flatness makes restriction preserve K-injectives. The shared derived-unit normalization uniquely identifies the direct-image restriction comparison and its mate.

The finite coefficient reduction pullback square gives the intrinsic finite exchange rectangle by naturality of mates. Transport the four evaluation corners with the normalized reduction evaluation comparison; naturality and the rectangle give all four finite arrow equalities.

Apply the normalized mate cube to the completed reduction pullback square. Its adjunction-mate normalization identifies the prescribed strict conjugate H inverse / reduction(exchange) / H-prime with the integral strict tower exchange mate.

Restriction of scalars respects the ordinary ringed inverse-image square. Apply the generic diagram lift, exact localization, and the mate cube, using the normalized direct-image comparisons. This gives the required equality with the constant coefficient tower mate, without deriving equality from evaluations.
